verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses, laying out these rules: 📣
‘Tell Israel: any Israelite or foreigner living there who gives a child as an offering to Molech must be put to death; the people of the land must stone them. ⚖️
I myself will stand against that person and cut them off from their people, because they gave their child to Molech, defiled my sanctuary, and dragged my holy name through it. ⚠️
If the people of the land see someone giving a child to Molech and just look away instead of putting that person to death, 👁️
I will stand against that person and their family and cut them off, along with everyone who follows their unfaithfulness to Molech. ⚖️
‘I will stand against and cut off anyone who turns to mediums or spiritists, going unfaithful by chasing them. 🚫
‘Set yourselves apart; live holy, because I am Yahweh your God. 🕊️
Keep my laws and put them into practice. I am Yahweh, the one who makes you holy. ✅
‘Anyone who curses their father or mother must be put to death; their own words bring that judgment on them. ⚖️
‘If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—his neighbor’s wife—both the man and the woman must be put to death. ⚖️
‘If a man sleeps with his father’s wife, he has dishonored his father. Both must be put to death; they brought that judgment on themselves. ⚠️
‘If a man sleeps with his daughter-in-law, both must be put to death. They’ve committed a perversion and brought that judgment on themselves. ⚖️
‘If a man lies with a man as he would with a woman, both have done what is detestable and must be put to death; they brought that judgment on themselves. ⚠️
‘If a man takes both a woman and her mother as wives, that is wickedness. He and both women must be burned with fire, so this wickedness doesn’t stay among you. ⚠️
‘If a man has sex with an animal, he must be put to death, and the animal must be killed too. ⚖️
‘If a woman goes to an animal and has sex with it, kill both the woman and the animal. They must die; that judgment is on them. ⚠️

‘If a man sleeps with his sister—his father’s daughter or his mother’s—and they see each other naked, it’s shameful. They must be cut off in front of their people; he has dishonored his sister and carries his guilt. ⚖️
‘If a man sleeps with a woman during her monthly flow, exposing her blood, both must be cut off from their people. 🌿
‘Don’t sleep with your mother’s sister or your father’s sister. He has dishonored close family, and both carry their guilt. ⚠️
If a man sleeps with his uncle’s wife, he has dishonored his uncle. They carry their sin and will die childless. ⚖️
‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, that is impurity; he has dishonored his brother, and they will be childless. ⚠️
‘Keep all my laws and instructions and live by them, so the land I’m bringing you to won’t spit you out. 📜
Don’t copy the customs of the nation I’m driving out ahead of you. They did all this, and I rejected them. 🚫
I’ve promised you their land to own—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am Yahweh your God, who set you apart from other peoples. 🏞️

‘Know the difference between clean animals and unclean ones, and clean birds and unclean birds. Don’t make yourselves detestable through animals, birds, or ground-crawlers I set apart as unclean for you. 🐾
You must be holy for me, because I, Yahweh, am holy. I’ve set you apart from other peoples to be mine. 🕊️
‘Any man or woman who is a medium or spiritist must be put to death by stoning. They brought that judgment on themselves.’ ⚖️
